reuse.why: Introduces a shared getMonthActionCategories and routes setZero, the average actions and the new setLastMonthSpending through it, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own getBudgetData-based filtering instead of using the selection.

duplication.why: The three set*MonthAvg SQL copies are collapsed, yet the exclusion rule (hidden, hidden group, goal_def, #fixed group) is decided twice: in getMonthActionCategories' SQL/filter and again as inline conditions in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: Selection helper, tag predicate and the new action all live in budget/actions.ts with the handler registered in budget/app.ts, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Changes stay within the four requested steps; the release note and tests are relevant.

maintainability.why: A future exclusion rule must be added in two places (the helper and copyPreviousMonth's branch chain), and getBudgetData is widened with group_note/goal_def only to serve that duplicate path.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts re-applies hidden/goal_def/#fixed exclusions inline instead of calling getMonthActionCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth re-expresses the SQL WHERE of getMonthActionCategories as per-row JS checks (hidden/group_hidden flag, goal_def != null, isFixedGroupNote) over getBudgetData rows, the same rule reshaped rather than shared.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthActionCategories gains includeHiddenCategories with a conditional SQL fragment (hiddenFilter); copyPreviousMonth bypasses the helper and re-implements its exclusions, each step adding another inline branch there.
